title: mdm.org_unit.changed.v1
description: An organization unit's (department's) complete current state; the record ID is its UUIDv7. A move changes the path of the unit and of every unit below it: each gets its own event. Also the data of SourceService for AGGREGATE_ORG_UNIT.

parent_id.description: null: a top unit of the legal entity

path.description: the org-tree fact of security 07: the legal entity's ID, then the unit IDs from the top down to this one, joined by /; compared by segment
